Lina (release): Quick sync: EU-north showing sporadic 502s for heavy embed+chat flows after SDK 2.8.0 + runtime 3.3.0 landed. Thinking a targeted SDK-side routing fallback for affected projects while runtime investigates.
Diego (runtime): We observed a subtle handshake mismatch between new batching shim and old kernel on certain quantized checkpoints. Not a universal crash but can cause worker timeouts under burst.
Nora (sdk): If we do a routing fallback, I can make SDK route traffic for projects with embed-heavy patterns to runtime 3.2.x in eu-north only. It would be a soft override (no customer-visible config change) and include an audit event.
Felix (cs): Heads-up: two customers reported degraded UX; they want an ETA. If pin helps, please include a note we9re doing a regional mitigation and will follow up.
Lina (release): Proposal: 1) Nora pushes SDK routing override for project_tag=heavy-embed in eu-north to runtime=3.2.2 for 3h window; 2) deploybot applies a routing label so Console shows it; 3) Diego runs quick compatibility tests and readout; 4) if stable extend or bake fix.
Diego (runtime): I9ll run a compatibility smoke: small set of embed+chat combos, 100 requests. Will surface any latency regressions.
Nora (sdk): I9ll prepare the override and rollback plan. deploybot, schedule apply in 2m with a 10m cooldown.
deploybot: Scheduling SDK routing override:
  action: override
  target: sdk-routing
  project_filter: tag=heavy-embed
  runtime: 3.2.2
  region: eu-north
  window: 3h
  cooldown: 10m
  initiated_by: Lina (release)
ci-bot: Preflight: routing dependency graph OK; capacity headroom 18% in eu-north; no active hotfixes.
Nora (sdk): Override applied. Console label: "eu-north-sdk-fallback-6151234567". Audit ID: sdkf-990.
Diego (runtime): Compatibility smoke (100 reqs): median latency unchanged, p95 +9ms, no timeouts. Worker queues normal.
Felix (cs): Sent quick note to affected customers mentioning regional mitigation and link to incident doc.
Lina (release): Good. Nora, add a follow-up to automate detection of affected projects (TICK-900). Diego, triage kernel-batching mismatch; if a patch is safe we can plan 3.3.1.
Nora (sdk): Follow-up filed. Also enabling a telemetry flag to surface SDK-side reroutes in Console.
Lina (release): Closing thread; will reopen if we see new errors or need to extend the window. :white_check_mark:
